findings.summary: RIG (fixed during cascade): the scripted puzzle driver never sent ArrowDown/Z undo/R restart — a manual probe proved all three work in-game (puzzle.js:90,181-182). The driver spec was fixed and the level re-run at the full 240s budget: all keys now fire (tap:ArrowDown/z/r + mash in trace) and the edge phase exercises, but the blind driver still places 0/3 crates — Sokoban-style puzzles need deliberate multi-push sequences a scripted tap loop cannot synthesize. Kept as a rig-coverage note, not a game defect.
The cross-level 'LIVES' caption in the left HUD (9px, dim gray) is nearly invisible against this level's light ice backdrop — '♥ ×3' reads fine but its label washes out at booth distance.

No auto-pause on window blur: trace t=197.4 blur event left #screen-pause inactive and play continued until refocus at t=201.9 (held keys are cleared on blur per src/core.js:321, so no stuck-key risk, but an unfocused booth level keeps running and burning state); acceptable if intended, otherwise add a pause-on-blur for the booth.
